book.title: MUSELU WAPAMA WA YESU woolebiwa ni Luka

content: Musibe wa Musadoro Oowarala
Yesu ahawaaddelaga anamasuuza aaye: “Wahikala mulobwana mmohiwa oreela; ole anna musadoro olene athu yamusumeliwa vameentoni va nabwiye wi ononoonga dhoreela dhaaye.
Vano nabwiye, ahimwiithana, omukoha: ‘Ginewiimi wa we si ddi? Ogaaddelihemo dha omusadoro waawo, mwaha wi dhiinova kunafwaneelela okala musadoro aaga.’
“Musadoro wiira mwa yeeka: ‘Gineere ddi? Vowi nabwiya aaga onogiigara mu omusadoroni. Olima mmiddani kaginaakwaniha, oloba teto onogikaliha manyazo...
Miyo gihinona yowi giire, wihina athu yagaakelele mmavade mweewa geegariwa mu omusadoroni’
“Ahawiithanihaga mmohi ni mmohi alene yamfiyarele nabwiye. Omukoha owambeela, wiira: ‘Mwamfiyaarile nabwiya aaga avi?’
“Oliye omwaakula: ‘Yoofiyaari yaaga si mino
zana dha makura.’ “Nuwindo musadoro wiira: ‘Okaraati, othukule karata ya yoofiyaari yaawo olebevo mowaaguva makumi matanu.’
“Vano, ahimukohaga anabiili: ‘Ki we, wafiyaare avi?’ “Oliye omwaakula: ‘Masakwi
zana a tirigu.’ “Omwiirela: ‘Thukula karata ya yofiyaari yaawo olebevo makumi matanu ni maraaru.’
“Vano nabwiye a musadoro oonyengetha ole, ahimutamalela mwaha wooxaga waaye wewiliiye. Mwaha wi athu a elabo ya vati booxaga okwaranya mulogo weewa oli mowaara.
Mbwenye Miyo Ginowuwaaddelani: Mulabihe dhoreela dha elabo yoonyengetha ela, wi akwiinyu dhoreeladha dhomalelani enodha yuwaakeleleni mmisasani dhohumala.
“Ole oli ororomeleya ni dhooyeva, onororomeleya teto ni dhijinji; ole ohunaharihamo ni dhooyeva kanaharihamo ni dhijinji.
Vowi, nyo mwahikale eebaribari ni dhoreela dhonyengetha, onororomeleni baani ni oreela wa ebaribari?
Akala muli ohuroromeleya ni weeddiha dhego dha mmoheene, onoovaheni baani weeddiha dhoreela dheenyu?

“Kalivo mwiimeleli onanda wawiimelela anabwiye abiili; vowi onadha amwiidde mmohi, amwandanena mmohiwa; naari oneerege omwiiwelela ola, mmohiwa amunyemulege. Kadhinandeya omwiimelela Mulugu, wiimelela dhoreela.
MaFarizi, ale yaali a nrima, yeewaga dhatedhene dhedhile, yombeddaga.

Yesu ahawiirelaga: “Nyo munowiihelamo woona owaakwanelesesa vameentoni va athu, mbwenye Mulugu ohunona mirima dheenyu. Vowi dhinarihedheya vameentoni va athu, vameentoni va Mulugu dhinakala dhonyemuwa.
Malamulo ni Omwene wa Mulugu

“Malamulo ni anamavuhulela yahivuhulela ofiyedha mudhidhi wa Zhuwawu. Okumela vevale odhowa osogolo onolaleyiwa muselu wapama wa Omwene wa Mulugu, vano athu ateene enaakwaniha ovolowa mwemule, ni kopolo, baahi.
Sookweya vajinji ovira odhulu ni elabo ya vati, ohiyana wi omorevo mujebo mmohi wa Malamulo.
“Oli ateene onamwalana ni mwihiyana aaye, amutela mmohi, onomuraruwana; ole onamutela mwihiyana omwalane ni mamune, onomuraruwana.
Musibe wa Mureeli ni Lazaro
“Ahikalawo mulobwana mmohi oreela; awaresa dhoowara dha mutheengo mulubale dha linyu oofewa, ni owiirihedha mathanga malubale, malabo mateene akala ni mukalelo wa athu oreelesesa.
Ahikalawo teto muliba oolobaloba, eeriwa Lazaro, anna makwadda mwiili wateene. Akalesa vamulago va muliba oreela ole,
oofunesa oja dhonyenyeya dhamoresa vameeza a muliba oreela. Vevale anabwa yodheesa, onyangulaga makwadda aaye.
“Dhahipadduwa muliba oolobaloba agakwile. Angero yahimuthukula, omudhowana wakala Abarahamu. Teto muliba oreela agakwile yahimudhowana omulogoha.
Arabulaga, azhaga omunddoni, mburo wa athu ookwa, ahisugwa odhulu, omoona Abarahamu ni Lazaro agali nikukuru.
Nuwindo, ahikuwaga, wiira: ‘Babani Abarahamu, mugeddiwele thagaraga, mmurume Lazaro anyethihe mmahinjeni otampini wa embuno yaaye adhena addiddilihena nlumi naaga, vowi ginorabula mmunddoni mula.’
“Abarahamu ahimwaakulaga, wiira: ‘Mwaanaga, wubuwele wi wahaakela dhego dhapama dhohagalasa egumi yaawo, wewule Lazaro aakelile dhorabula. Mbwenye dhiinova, oliye onahagalala wuno, we onorabula.
Ohiya dhatedhene, vaari va hiyo ni nyo vihikala jiji, vowi eli wuno enafuna odha wo, kinaakwaniha, naari eli wo, enafuna odha wuno kinaakwaniha.’
“Nuwindo, ahikalelaga ntidi, eeraga: ‘Babani, miyo ginowulobani wi mmurume Lazaro adhowe vade va ababa,
mwaha wi gihikanna addibilaga atanu. Awaaddele wi ni aliwene enadhe teto mburo olena wa masoso.’
“Abarahamu ahimwaakulaga: ‘Aliwa ehikanna Mozezi ni anamavuhulela, yawiiwelelege aliweene.’
“ Mbwenye oliye ahikalelaga ntidi: ‘Naari, babani Abarahamu, akalavo mmohi ovenyile mwa anookwa adhowa awoga ni aliwa, enotthwaruwa.’
“Abarahamu ahimwaakulaga: ‘Akala aliwa kinamwiiwelele Mozezi ni onamavuhulela, nivang'onong'ono kinafunege ogonjihiwa wi ehiye naari muthu mmohi avenye omakwelo.’”
